title: Enforce Workspace Reachability And Dependency Hygiene
forbids: unreachable authored files, unused non-entry exports, duplicate exports, undeclared or unused dependencies, unresolved imports, and stale Knip configuration
why: Knip owns workspace reachability and dependency analysis; package export maps and exact positive-kind gateways declare public entrypoints, Habitat registers the zero-corpus invariant, and Nx schedules the native analyzer exactly once.
remediate: Run `nx run habitat:check:dead-code`, then delete dead code or model the exact executable, generated, public, positive-kind, dynamic, or virtual owner.
message: The workspace must remain free of truthful Knip reachability, dependency, duplicate-export, and configuration findings.
